title: Preparation of 0.2M EDTA, pH 8.0
author: Nicola O'Reilly
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfexjjfn
materials: Please select between the recipes for 1 L 0.2 M EDTA pH 8.0 and 2 L 0.2 M EDTA pH 8.0 . Work in fume hood!

steps.title: Prepare 1 L of 0.2M EDTA
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1 L solution of 0.2M EDTA at pH 8.0.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 74.45 g EDTA disodium salt, dihydrate and add to a 1 L beaker.
Add 800 mL MilliQ water to the beaker.
Add a magnetic flea and place on a magnetic stirring plate to mix.
Insert a newly calibrated pH meter into the solution.
Add NaOH pellets a few at a time, waiting for full dissolution between additions, until pH 8.0 is reached (approximately 8 g of pellets may be required).
Fine tune the pH to 8.0 using 5 M NaOH.
Once fully dissolved, transfer to a 1 L beaker and top up to 1 L with MilliQ water if necessary.

steps.title: Prepare 2 L of 0.2M EDTA
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2 L solution of 0.2M EDTA at pH 8.0.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 148.89 g EDTA disodium salt, dihydrate and add to a 2 L beaker.
Add 1600 mL MilliQ water to the beaker.
Add a magnetic flea and place on a magnetic stirring plate to mix.
Insert a newly calibrated pH meter into the solution.
Add NaOH pellets a few at a time, waiting for full dissolution between additions, until pH 8.0 is reached (approximately 16 g of pellets may be required).
Fine tune the pH to 8.0 using 5 M NaOH.
Once fully dissolved, transfer to a 2 L beaker and top up to 2 L with MilliQ water if necessary.

steps.title: Label and Store Solution
steps.instruction: Label the prepared 0.2 M EDTA pH 8.0 solution with the batch and date.

substeps.instruction: Store the solution at room temperature (15 °C – 25 °C).
